dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would you even think that...

dialogues.speaker: Qiongjiu
dialogues.text: If I could fish up some jade while fishing, then I could play with Muli every day...

dialogues.speaker: Qiongjiu
dialogues.text: Even though fishing is fun, making jadeware is more interesting still.

dialogues.speaker: Qiongjiu
dialogues.text: But if I don't put in the effort and practice fishing as my family wants, my parents' techniques will be lost forever.

dialogues.speaker: Qiongjiu
dialogues.text: If only Little Mao was willing to learn how to fish...
